interface.name: linura_display_manager_v1
interface.description: Experimental adapter protocol, compiled with the exact reviewed compositor. This is an unprivileged compositor mechanism, never Linura policy, approval, execution authority or a public client SDK. Linura calls it only from its protected native owner after prepared executor admission. Correlation values are not credentials. A pending attempt and its restoration timer outlive all client resources. Only its original live connection may confirm it.

request.name: admit_startup

description.summary: retain the original supervised startup lease

request.description: Only the freshly admitted protected owner may transfer the root protection service's original descriptor. This cannot restore outputs, change lock state, renew a timer or replace an earlier admission.

interface.name: linura_display_snapshot_v1
interface.description: Identity is followed by at most 16 heads, then done. All unsigned 64-bit numbers use high and low 32-bit words. Snapshot objects, modes and output lifetimes are adapter details. A configuration must use this same client's live snapshot, whose original kernel-clock timestamp remains binding.

event.name: original_restoration_presentation
event.description: At most one bounded private JSON object, before done. Requires fresh actual KMS state and hardware completion of current immutable opaque buffers after the final source write. Startup/retired frames, queued disable acknowledgements and desired-state caches cannot supply it. This is observation only and cannot release any fence or retire history.

event.name: native_handoff_presentation

description.summary: first ordinary-frame comparison with original deadlines

event.description: At most one bounded private JSON object before done, mutually exclusive with opaque original_restoration_presentation. Requires the same retained scene, authenticated one-use terminal spend, actual immutable ordinary frames, per-output spend/completion counters and current native KMS. Original absolute wall and BOOTTIME deadlines are preserved. Read-only reconciliation cannot replay a spend, adopt another frame, renew time, complete durable history or retire input, lock, power or startup fences.

event.name: native_current_presentation

description.summary: current scanout after the authenticated handoff

event.description: Bounded comparison facts, mutually exclusive with restoration and first frame facts. Requires a live original Root completion lifetime for this invocation, actual current KMS and completed ordinary buffers after the handoff boundary. Input retirement reflects native physical Escape and drain state. Fresh sampling cannot renew or replay execution authority, retire power or complete Root or Control history.

event.name: ordinary_handoff_presentation
event.description: At most one bounded private object before done, mutually exclusive with other presentation events. Requires the exact consumed fresh ordinary review, live original Root producer window and one-use spend, actual post-spend completed ordinary buffers and current KMS on every output. The complete preparation digest and terminal lineage remain bound to this ordinary invocation. No completion or fence retirement authority.

interface.name: linura_display_head_v1

description.summary: native output lifetime in one snapshot

interface.description: At most 128 exact advertised mode tuples, one current event, an optional mirror event, then done. Disabled current geometry is all zero. A mirror refers to the exact native handle and generation in the same snapshot. Covered includes the compositor's protective black fallback; Linura still independently verifies its own native lock surfaces before commitment.

event.name: recovery_witness
event.description: Exactly one bounded witness precedes head done. These source-versioned native values prove no continuity after replacement and grant no effect. The protected owner hashes native rule/identity data before publication.

interface.name: linura_display_attempt_v1

description.summary: one bounded display attempt with independent restoration

interface.description: Configure and target requests stage data and never cause output effects. Apply is one-use and requires the complete exact captured inventory. A repeated get_attempt is observation-only unless it is the original live connection. Lost replies never grant permission to apply again. No status acknowledges success as a substitute for independent native verification.

request.name: apply

description.summary: retain the consumed native protection resource

request.description: The interaction must be the original live consumed Apply scene on this same attested connection. It is retained independently through modeset and restoration. Strings or a newly created scene cannot replace it.

request.name: restore_original
request.description: Only a replacement with unresolved startup recovery may consume this distinct prepared operation. Its original Root endpoint, complete native source and consumed Recovery scene must all verify before any write. This never reuses Apply, confirms a layout or releases a fence. Lost replies and destroyed resources cannot replay the consumed stream.

request.name: apply_successor

description.summary: transfer original ownership to a fresh prepared Apply

request.description: The sealed comparison must bind Root's exact completed predecessor, new prepared checkpoint and original native sample clocks. The current compositor separately spends the original credential-bearing Root channel. Neither the descriptor nor its bytes grants authority. Both protections remain held on uncertain acknowledgement; no replay.
